title: Local Weak Cosmic Censorship in Charged Spherical Collapse
exact_target: Determine whether the final center point of generic charged spherical collapse is locally hidden.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004810 (OWR-8415343-013). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2021), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2021/40, pp. 2157--2267. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The charged collapse model and meaning of genericity are those of the source; neither an uncharged variant nor a universal assertion for every initial datum is substituted.
